audit.why: HARD 8/10 assassin lane — Talon owns all-ins and roam tempo, TF wins via yellow-card discipline and map play; 53.16% over 2912 games reflects TF converting the map.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text, whys[4], mid and wants.foe[1] name 'Cutthroat' — Talon's removed pre-rework ability. His E is Assassin's Path (wall vault) and his R is Shadow Assault; Q Noxian Diplomacy refunds on kill.
audit.why: The kit file lists P Blade's End, Q Noxian Diplomacy, W Rake, E Assassin's Path, R Shadow Assault — no Cutthroat exists.
audit.corrected: All four fields rewritten with real ability names at the same length.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides said Talon on all 7 rows while content win[] says Skill at rows 2, 3, 6 (packet defect: chart gives Talon 4/7 while TF wins 53.16%); breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two bleed bullets.
audit.why: Content whys ground the Skill rows (spaced stun at 3, even farm at 4-5, two-item pick parity); Rake is 9s at rank 1, Shadow Assault 100/80/60s.
audit.corrected: Chart rows 2, 3, 6 aligned to Skill with matching whys and ratings; cooldown numbers added; bleed bullets rewritten to their titles.

audit.why: TF's Destiny reveals stealth (Riot text) — it exposes Shadow Assault's invisibility; already implied by the reveal flag but not stated on the page; folded into the cooldowns rewrite.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: Level 3 skill test: his W-Q all-in is real, but your spaced yellow card lands first and turns it around.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay even — you both farm, and his all-in needs a setup your range and a held card can dodge.

edits.before: Late TF is a coin with two good sides: split the side lane R-safe, or hold Destiny as the pick-and-collapse button.
edits.after: Two-plus items your Red Card waveclear and Destiny picks even the scaling — pick and collapse, never duel him.

edits.before: - Talon Rake: matchup-defining — The boomerang return is most of his lane damage — stand off the return line. Check it before every step-up. - W gold card is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Talon Rake: 9s at rank 1 — the boomerang return is most of his lane damage; stand off the return line and step up while it is down. - Shadow Assault is 100s at rank 1, and your Destiny reveals him through its stealth. - W gold card is the lifeline.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: A freeze at your tower kills his 575-range Q leap — he cannot open on you under turret without eating yellow card first.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: With yellow card spent, Q leap into Rake return and the Blade's End bleed kills a plate-greeding TF before the deck recycles.

edits.before: At 6 his Cutthroat-reset burst kills you outright while your Destiny is only a map tool in lane.
edits.after: At 6 his Shadow Assault burst kills you outright while your Destiny is only a map tool in lane.

edits.before: Talon 6 with Rake refunds and Cutthroat lets him ignore your wave and hop walls to gank or delete you; your Destiny 6 is a global map tool, not a duel button here.
edits.after: Talon 6 adds Shadow Assault stealth burst, and Assassin's Path wall-hops turn him into a gank machine; your Destiny 6 is a global map tool, not a duel button.

edits.before: From 3 through 6 he owns the all-in with the Rake-Cutthroat combo and roams off the wall faster than you; respect his kill threat and prioritize shoving to leave lane on your terms.
edits.after: From 3 through 6 he owns the all-in with the Rake into Noxian Diplomacy combo and roams via Assassin's Path faster than you; respect the kill threat and shove to leave on your terms.

edits.before: Land the double-tick Rake bleed then Cutthroat in for the reset kill
edits.after: Land the double-tick Rake bleed then Q-leap in for the reset kill

notes: Killed the fabricated/removed ability 'Cutthroat' in four content fields — Talon's current kit has no such ability (E is Assassin's Path, R Shadow Assault). suspectNames 'Gold Card' in wants.you[2] is a false positive: Gold Card is TF's own W pick card, correctly named. Packet defect about the chart resolved by aligning full rows 2, 3, 6 to the content layer's Skill; the remaining Talon rows are grounded (levels 1-2, 6, first item are genuinely his) and TF's 53.16% WR comes from map conversion, so no further flips. Added the verified Destiny-reveals-stealth vs Shadow Assault interaction to breakdown.cooldowns (Riot's R text). sectionsMissing: breakdown.carry, breakdown.late, ahead, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid remain TF-generic templates; left rather than invent.
